symptom: PC could ping server IP but server.local initially failed
show_output: ping 192.168.1.20 successful; ping server.local initially failed
expected_fault: Incorrect DNS Server configuration on PC

symptom: PC can ping server IP but cannot resolve server.local
expected_fault: Missing DNS A record for server.local
fix: Add server.local A record pointing to 192.168.1.20

symptom: server.local resolves to an incorrect IP address and ping fails
show_output: ping server.local resolves to 192.168.1.99; 4 packets lost
expected_fault: Incorrect IP address in DNS A record
fix: Change server.local A record from 192.168.1.99 to 192.168.1.20

symptom: PC can reach the server IP but cannot resolve server.local because DNS service is disabled
expected_fault: DNS service is disabled on the server

symptom: PC0 cannot communicate with PC1 due to an incorrect subnet mask
show_output: PC0 was configured with subnet mask 255.255.255.128 while PC1 was configured with 255.255.255.0
expected_fault: Incorrect subnet mask assigned to PC0
verification: Ping from PC0 to 192.168.10.130 successful with 0% packet loss

symptom: PC0 cannot communicate with PC1 because it is configured in a different subnet
expected_fault: PC0 was assigned an IP address from the wrong subnet
fix: Change PC0 IP address to 192.168.10.10 with subnet mask 255.255.255.0
verification: Ping from PC0 to 192.168.10.20 successful with 0% packet loss

symptom: Host cannot communicate because a broadcast address was assigned as a host IP
show_output: PC0 was assigned 192.168.10.255/24, which is the broadcast address of the 192.168.10.0/24 network
expected_fault: Broadcast address was incorrectly assigned to a host
fix: Replace the broadcast address with a valid host IP such as 192.168.10.10
verification: Ping from PC0 to 192.168.10.20 successful with 0% packet loss

symptom: PC0 is configured with an incorrect default gateway (192.168.10.99) instead of the correct gateway (192.168.10.1)
expected_fault: Incorrect default gateway prevents PC0 from communicating with the remote network
fix: Change PC0 default gateway from 192.168.10.99 to 192.168.10.1
verification: Ping succeeds with 0% packet loss after correcting the default gateway

symptom: PC0 is configured with an incorrect subnet mask (255.255.255.128) instead of 255.255.255.0
expected_fault: Incorrect subnet mask causes incorrect network identification and communication failure
verification: Communication succeeds with 0% packet loss after correcting the subnet mask

symptom: PC1 is configured with an IP address from the wrong network (192.168.3.10)
expected_fault: PC1 belongs to the wrong network, so communication with PC0 fails
fix: Configure PC1 with an IP address from the correct network
verification: Communication succeeds with 0% packet loss after correcting the IP network

symptom: PC0 cannot ping PC1 because an ACL blocks ICMP traffic
expected_fault: ACL rule denies ICMP traffic from 192.168.10.10 to 192.168.20.10
fix: Remove the ACL from G0/0 and delete ACL 100

symptom: PC0 cannot ping PC1 because the ACL is applied in the wrong direction
expected_fault: ACL 101 is applied in the wrong direction on Router0 G0/1
fix: Remove ACL 101 from G0/1 outbound direction

symptom: PC0 cannot ping PC1 because the ACL denies traffic between the two networks
expected_fault: ACL 102 denies traffic from 192.168.10.0/24 to 192.168.20.0/24 without a required permit rule
fix: Replace the deny-only ACL with a permit rule allowing the required traffic
